messages:
InfraBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT alert — shared-gpu-pool-3 p99 latency breach for model-service > 2.0s. Current p99=3.8s, p95=1.6s. Streaming stalls spike, 37% of streaming sessions experiencing stalls. Affected tenants: tenant-42, tenant-17, tenant-88. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/latency?pool=shared-gpu-pool-3

Ava (oncall): ACK. Paging now. I'm on it. @Ben @Carla can you join? Need quick impact assessment and mitigation plan.

Ben: Oncall here. Looking at traces — majority of long tails are on gpu-node-12 and gpu-node-13. I see large blkio wait times and cgroup io.throttle events. p99 token latency spikes line up with heavy write bursts from tenant-42.

Carla: 2nded. tenant-42 started a heavy eval job ~12:34 UTC, high throughput dataset writes to local checkpointing. Likely noisy neighbor IO. Streaming stalls increase because KV cache IO and eviction delays.

Ava (oncall): Customer impact? any 5xxs or aborted streams?

Ben: Error rate up to 0.8% overall, but three customers see >2% error/retry: acme-corp, finlytics, chatly. Most are retryable stalls on streaming (client reconnects). Estimated rps impacted ~8% of total.

Carla: Repro timeline: heavy writes started at 12:33, p99 climbed after 12:36. cgroup blkio throttling metrics: blkio.throttle.io_serviced=high and io_wait spikes.

Ava (oncall): Triage plan: 1) move noisy tenant off shared pool to isolated-gpu-pool-2; 2) temporarily bump cgroup blkio limits for affected nodes as short-term; 3) enable streaming fallback for sessions from affected customers to fallback-rt nodes; 4) continue to monitor and then roll to eng-sre for follow-up. Who can run tenant move?

Ben: I can run the move. Command I'll use: ```redwood ctl tenant move --tenant tenant-42 --from shared-gpu-pool-3 --to isolated-gpu-pool-2 --live-migrate```

Ben: Kickoff now. Live migration started. Logs: "migration: streams draining -> copy checkpoint -> attach to new pool". Progress: 30% copied.

Carla: While migration running, I'll apply temporary blkio bump on gpu-node-12/13 to relieve immediate stalls. Running: ```
# on gpu-node-12
sudo bash -c 'echo "8:0 12500000" > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/blkio.throttle.write_bps_device'
```

Carla: Applied on gpu-node-12 and gpu-node-13. Observing immediate drop in iowait on node-level metrics. Streaming stalls measure down from 37% -> 18% over 2 mins.

Ben: Migration finished, tenant-42 now in isolated-gpu-pool-2. Confirming: traffic flows stable, no more heavy writes on shared pool.

Ava (oncall): Good. Rollback the temporary blkio bumps to prod-safe settings once stable. Also enable streaming fallback for the three impacted customers for 30m as precaution. 

SRE_Bot: Executing streaming fallback for acme-corp, finlytics, chatly -> fallback-rt cluster. Command: ```redwood route update --match tenant in [acme-corp,finlytics,chatly] --set pool=fallback-rt --ttl 1800```

SRE_Bot: Route update applied. Confirmed sessions now hitting fallback-rt nodes. Immediate errors for those customers drop to <0.2%.

Ben: Post-mitigation metrics: p99 for model-service on shared-gpu-pool-3 down to 1.1s, p95=0.9s. Streaming stalls down to 2.1%. Overall error rate back to baseline.

Ava (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated. Actions for follow-up: - eng-sre to investigate why tenant-42 wasn't autosandboxed by QoS rules - add additional cgroup IO guardrails and predictive throttling - consider prefilling KV cache or moving checkpoint writes off local SSDs - add runbook step for live tenant moves during high IO.

Carla: I'll open a follow-up ticket with logs, node-level blkio metrics, and migration timeline. Tagging eng-sre and infra.

Ben: Noted. I'll also add an annotation to tenant-42 to restrict parallel checkpointing concurrency by default.

Ava (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing to eng-sre oncall for postmortem and long-term fixes. @Carla @Ben please join triage at 15:00 UTC. Closing this thread after PM created. :white_check_mark:

SRE_Bot: INCIDENT mitigated — p99 target restored. Create incident PR and postmortem template: https://internal.redwood/incidents/new?parent=1761234567

Ava (oncall): Thanks team. Good quick coordination. We'll follow up in the postmortem. (reacted :thumbsup:)
